React Select pattern — country

Hand-written DOM matching React Select v5's rendered output (combobox + role=listbox + role=option). Click the field to open. Expected: United States moves to the top.

Note: we don't load the real react-select bundle because its UMD global name changes between minor versions. This DOM is identical to what react-select renders.
